title: Unforgettable way to see Barcelona!
text:
We had the absolute best time on this English-speaking small-group e-bike tour! Exploring Barcelona on an e-bike was smooth, effortless, and allowed us to see so much more of the city than we ever could have on foot—all without breaking a sweat.
Our guide, Misha, was fantastic! Misha was warm, engaging, and incredibly knowledgeable, sharing rich local history, fascinating stories, and hidden gems along the route. Because it was a small group, the experience felt personal, relaxed, and interactive. We always felt completely safe navigating the city's bike paths and streets.

title: Interesting, leisurely ride around Barcelona
text: We loved this tour. Our guide was friendly and knowledgeable and the ride was well planned to see a number of interesting sights. The route was largely on pavements & cycle lanes with short stretches on the road and it felt very safe. The pace was leisurely.
